class.name: SpriteStudioPlayer2D
class.brief_description: Plays a SpriteStudio 7 animation ([code].ssab[/code]) in a 2D scene.
class.description: Node that plays a SpriteStudio 7 animation imported as an [code].ssab[/code] resource ([SSABResource]). Assign a resource to [member ssab], pick an animation with [member animation], then drive playback from code with [method play], [method pause] and [method stop], or preview it in the editor from the [b]SpriteStudio[/b] bottom panel (shown while the node is selected). [b]Editor preview:[/b] with the node selected, the bottom panel provides transport controls (play from start / play from current / stop), a frame scrubber, loop and speed. Its keyboard shortcuts mirror the AnimationPlayer editor ([kbd]D[/kbd] play from current, [kbd]Shift+D[/kbd] play from start, [kbd]S[/kbd] stop).

method.name: advance
method.description: Steps playback by [param delta] seconds and emits [signal frame_updated], exactly as an automatic tick would - so part attachments and anything else driven by that signal stay in step. Meant for [constant ANIMATION_PROCESS_MANUAL], which is the mode that stops the node ticking itself. Calling it under the other two modes advances the animation [i]on top of[/i] the node's own tick rather than instead of it. [codeblock] func _process(delta: float) -> void: # A slow-motion group the engine's own time scale must not touch. $SpriteStudioPlayer2D.advance(delta * slowmo_factor) [/codeblock]

method.name: play
method.description: Starts playback. [param start_frame] of [code]-1.0[/code] (the default) [b]rewinds to the start of the playback section[/b] - its end when [method set_playback_direction] is set to [constant PLAYBACK_DIRECTION_BACKWARD] - rather than continuing from where the playhead is. Pass [method get_frame] to play on from the current position. This is a fresh start, not a resume: it re-arms the loop counter and clears the paused state. Resuming a pause is [method pause]'s own toggle.

method.name: pause
method.description: Toggles the paused state, keeping the current frame: calling [method pause] again while paused resumes playback. A paused animation is still considered playing ([method is_playing] returns [code]true[/code]); use [method is_pausing] to detect the paused state.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback. The playhead [b]stays where it was[/b], so the node keeps drawing the frame it stopped on; seek with [member frame] or start over with [method play] if you want it elsewhere.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the animation is playing, [b]including while it is paused[/b]. Use [method is_pausing] to distinguish a paused animation.

method.name: is_pausing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while playback is paused.

method.name: get_total_frames
method.description: Returns the total number of frames in the current animation.

method.name: get_start_frame
method.description: Returns the first frame that plays - the start of the current playback section, which is frame [code]0[/code] until [method set_animation_section] narrows it. Same value as [member animation_section_start].

method.name: get_end_frame
method.description: Returns the last frame that plays - the end of the current playback section, which is the animation's last frame until [method set_animation_section] narrows it. Same value as [member animation_section_end].

method.name: set_animation_section
method.description: Limits playback to the inclusive frame range [code][start, end][/code].

method.name: set_playback_direction
method.description: Sets the playback direction and style.

method.name: get_playback_direction
method.description: Returns the direction half of [method set_playback_direction].

method.name: get_playback_style
method.description: Returns the style half of [method set_playback_direction].

method.name: set_cellmap_texture
method.description: Overrides the texture used for the named cell map. Pass an invalid texture to clear the override.

method.name: get_cellmap_texture
method.description: Returns the texture currently bound to [param cellmap_name] - the override set by [method set_cellmap_texture] when there is one, otherwise the texture loaded from the [code].ssab[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] when the cell map is unknown.

method.name: get_cellmap_names
method.description: Names of the cell maps in the assigned [SSABResource] (without the [code].ssce[/code] extension), or an empty array when no resource is assigned. Pass one of these to [method get_cell_names] or [method set_part_cell_override].

method.name: get_cell_names
method.description: Names of the cells inside [param cellmap_name], or an empty array when no resource is assigned or the cell map is unknown.

method.name: get_part_names
method.description: Returns every part name in the bound [member ssab]. Parts belong to the asset rather than to one animation, so the list is the same whichever animation is selected. Empty when no resource is assigned.

method.name: get_part_index
method.description: Resolves a part name to its index, or [code]-1[/code] when the asset has no such part. Indices are stable within one [code].ssab[/code], so code that sets overrides often should resolve once here and use the [code]_by_index[/code] methods afterwards.

method.name: get_part_transform
method.description: Returns the part's transform on the current frame, in this node's local space with [member flip_h], [member flip_v] and [member offset] already applied. Multiply by [code]global_transform[/code] for world space. Returns the identity when the part is unknown. Parts nested inside an Instance part cannot be addressed - the child animation runs as a separate player - though the Instance part itself can. For continuous following, [SpriteStudioPartAttachment2D] does this every frame.

method.name: is_part_hidden
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the part is hidden on the current frame, by the animation or by [method set_part_visibility_override]. Returns [code]false[/code] when the part is unknown.

method.name: set_part_color_override
method.description: Tints one part with a single color, winning over both the keyframes and any animation blending. Applies to normal (image) parts; other part types ignore it silently and the call still returns [code]true[/code]. Colors are read in the same 8-bit sRGB space as the authored Part Color and the runtime pre-multiplies alpha, so pass the color as authored. Returns [code]false[/code] when the part is unknown or the runtime rejects the call. See [enum ColorBlendOperation] and [enum OverridePriority].

method.name: set_part_cell_override
method.description: Makes one part draw a different cell. [param cellmap_name] is written without the [code].ssce[/code] suffix; [method get_cellmap_names] and [method get_cell_names] enumerate what can be passed. The lookup happens now, so an unknown cell map or cell fails immediately and returns [code]false[/code]. Where [method set_cellmap_texture] swaps a whole texture for every part that samples it, this changes what a single part draws.

method.name: set_part_visibility_override
method.description: Force-hides a part regardless of the keyframes; [param force_hidden] of [code]false[/code] hands visibility back to the animation. With [param cascade] the part's descendants are hidden too. Unlike the color and cell overrides this takes no priority: it always wins, and it is always dropped when a new animation is set up. Hiding an Instance part also stops its contents from drawing.

method.name: clear_part_color_override
method.description: Drops the part's color override, whether it was set by [method set_part_color_override] or [method set_part_color_override_corners] - the two share one slot.

method.name: clear_part_cell_override
method.description: Drops the part's cell override, so it draws the cell the animation keys again.

method.name: clear_part_visibility_override
method.description: Drops the part's visibility override, so the animation decides again whether it draws.

method.name: clear_all_part_overrides
method.description: Drops every override on every part of this player. Assigning a different [member ssab] does this on its own, because part identity is lost with the asset.

method.name: set_part_color_override_by_index
method.description: [method set_part_color_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index], skipping the name lookup.

method.name: set_part_color_override_corners_by_index
method.description: [method set_part_color_override_corners] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index], skipping the name lookup.

method.name: set_part_cell_override_by_index
method.description: [method set_part_cell_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index], skipping the name lookup.

method.name: set_part_visibility_override_by_index
method.description: [method set_part_visibility_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index], skipping the name lookup.

method.name: clear_part_color_override_by_index
method.description: [method clear_part_color_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index].

method.name: clear_part_cell_override_by_index
method.description: [method clear_part_cell_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index].

method.name: clear_part_visibility_override_by_index
method.description: [method clear_part_visibility_override] addressed by the index from [method get_part_index].

method.name: set_part_color_override_corners
method.description: Overrides a part's color with a distinct color per corner, producing a gradient across the part. See [enum ColorBlendOperation] and [enum OverridePriority] for [param blend_op] and [param priority]. Shares one override slot with [method set_part_color_override], so the last call wins and [method clear_part_color_override] clears either kind. Returns [code]false[/code] when the part is unknown or the runtime rejects the call.

members.member: The SpriteStudio animation resource ([code].ssab[/code]) to play.
Name of the animation to play, chosen from the animations contained in [member ssab].
If [code]true[/code], the selected animation starts playing automatically when the scene runs.
The drawing offset of the animation. Useful for visually centering an animation without altering the node's Transform.
If [code]true[/code], the animation is flipped horizontally.
If [code]true[/code], the animation is flipped vertically.

Determines whether to advance the animation in [code]_physics_process[/code] ([constant ANIMATION_PROCESS_PHYSICS]) or [code]_process[/code] ([constant ANIMATION_PROCESS_IDLE]). Use Physics if the parent node moves using the physics engine to avoid jitter. [constant ANIMATION_PROCESS_MANUAL] stops the node advancing itself, leaving playback to [method advance].
First frame of the played section, inclusive. Setting it keeps [member animation_section_end]; use [method set_animation_section] to move both endpoints at once.
Last frame of the played section, inclusive. Setting it keeps [member animation_section_start]; use [method set_animation_section] to move both endpoints at once.
Current playback frame (editor-only display). Can be keyframed from an [AnimationPlayer] to drive playback from a timeline.
Playback speed multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal speed.
Number of loops. [code]-1[/code] loops forever, [code]0[/code] plays once, [code]n[/code] repeats [code]n[/code] times.
If [code]true[/code], frames may be skipped to keep real-time playback under load.
If [code]true[/code], interpolates between integer frames for smoother sub-frame playback.

If [code]true[/code], the built-in audio player plays the sounds emitted by the animation's audio parts. Set to [code]false[/code] to handle audio yourself via the [signal audio] signal. Audio is fired-and-forgotten: it plays only when its frame is passed during forward playback (reverse playback does not play sound), it is not resynced on seek, and it keeps playing while the animation is paused.
Volume of the built-in audio playback, as a linear value in [code][0, 1][/code]. Ignored when [member audio_backend] is set.
Optional override backend. When assigned, built-in playback is suppressed and each audio event is routed to the backend's [code]play_audio[/code] method instead (e.g. to drive audio middleware).

signal.name: animation_started
signal.description: Emitted when playback of an animation starts.

signal.name: animation_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the current animation changes.

signal.name: animation_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a non-looping animation reaches its end.

signal.name: animation_looped
signal.description: Emitted each time a looping animation wraps around.

signal.name: user_data
signal.description: Emitted when a user-data key on the timeline is reached. [param payload] always carries the event's origin - [code]part_index[/code], [code]part_name[/code] and [code]frame_no[/code] (the frame the key sits on, not necessarily the frame it was noticed on) - plus whichever of [code]integer[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]rect[/code] and [code]string[/code] the animator filled in. A value left unset is absent from the dictionary rather than zero.

signal.name: signal_emitted
signal.description: Emitted when a signal attribute on the timeline fires. [param command] is the command id and [param value] holds its parameters, keyed by the parameter ids authored in SpriteStudio. [param info] is kept separate precisely because those keys are author-defined: it carries [code]part_index[/code], [code]part_name[/code] and [code]frame_no[/code].

signal.name: audio
signal.description: Emitted when an audio part fires an audio event. [param payload] carries [code]part_index[/code], [code]part_name[/code], [code]frame_no[/code], [code]sound_list_name_hash[/code], [code]sound_name_hash[/code], [code]sound_name[/code] and [code]loop_num[/code] (the play count). This is an observation channel and fires in every playback direction (and in the editor), independently of [member play_audio].

signal.name: frame_updated
signal.description: Emitted after the animation state has been evaluated for [param frame_no], before the parts are drawn. Connect to this to read part poses in the same frame they render, independently of [member animation_process_mode]. [SpriteStudioPartAttachment2D] uses this signal internally.

constants.constant: The node does not advance the animation on its own; call [method advance] to step it. Audio voices already sounding still tick, since they are fire-and-forget and outlive the frame that started them.
Plays the animation from the section start towards its end.
Plays the animation from the section end towards its start. Audio parts do not fire while playing backwards.
Each loop restarts from the same end of the section.
Playback reverses at each end of the section instead of restarting.
Blends the override color over the part's color.
Multiplies the part's color by the override color.
Adds the override color to the part's color.
Subtracts the override color from the part's color.
The override is dropped as soon as the animation next keys the attribute.
The override is held until another animation is set up. This is the default.
The override survives animation changes and is only removed by an explicit clear.
